# Tipe Data Primitif

## Integer

Go memiliki berbagai ukuran integer:

| Tipe | Ukuran | Range |
|---|---|---|
| `int8` | 8 bit | -128 to 127 |
| `int16` | 16 bit | -32,768 to 32,767 |
| `int32` | 32 bit | -2,147,483,648 to 2,147,483,647 |
| `int64` | 64 bit | -9.2×10¹⁸ to 9.2×10¹⁸ |
| `int` | 32 atau 64 bit | Tergantung platform |
| `uint8` | 8 bit | 0 to 255 |
| `uint16` | 16 bit | 0 to 65,535 |
| `uint32` | 32 bit | 0 to 4,294,967,295 |
| `uint64` | 64 bit | 0 to 1.8×10¹⁹ |
| `uint` | 32 atau 64 bit | Tergantung platform |

```go
import "math"

var a int = 42
var b int64 = 9_000_000_000  // underscore sebagai pemisah
var c uint = 255

fmt.Println(math.MaxInt)    // max value untuk int
fmt.Println(math.MaxInt64)  // max value untuk int64
```

## Float

```go
var f32 float32 = 3.14          // presisi ~6-7 digit
var f64 float64 = 3.14159265358 // presisi ~15-17 digit (lebih disarankan)

fmt.Printf("float32: %.7f\n", f32) // 3.1400001 (ada error presisi)
fmt.Printf("float64: %.11f\n", f64) // 3.14159265358
```

## Boolean

```go
var benar bool = true
var salah bool = false

fmt.Println(benar && salah) // false (AND)
fmt.Println(benar || salah) // true  (OR)
fmt.Println(!benar)          // false (NOT)
```

## String

String di Go adalah urutan byte yang **immutable** (tidak bisa diubah setelah dibuat).

```go
var s string = "Hello, Go!"

fmt.Println(len(s))    // 10 (panjang byte)
fmt.Println(s[0])      // 72 (nilai byte dari 'H')
fmt.Println(s[0:5])    // Hello (slice)
fmt.Println(s + " " + "World") // concatenation
```

### Iterasi string
```go
for i, r := range "Go!" {
    fmt.Printf("index %d: %c (%d)\n", i, r, r)
}
```

## Rune (int32) dan Byte (uint8)

```go
var r rune = 'A'       // rune = int32, untuk karakter Unicode
var b byte = 'z'       // byte = uint8, untuk karakter ASCII

fmt.Println(r)         // 65 (kode ASCII 'A')
fmt.Printf("%c\n", r) // A
fmt.Println(b)         // 122 (kode ASCII 'z')
```

Perbedaan rune vs byte:
- `byte` (`uint8`) — untuk karakter ASCII (0-127)
- `rune` (`int32`) — untuk karakter Unicode (mendukung semua bahasa)

## Contoh Lengkap Semua Tipe

```go
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
    var i int = 100
    var f float64 = 9.81
    var b bool = true
    var s string = "Golang"
    var r rune = '\u00e9'  // é
    var by byte = 'A'

    fmt.Printf("%T = %v\n", i, i)
    fmt.Printf("%T = %v\n", f, f)
    fmt.Printf("%T = %v\n", b, b)
    fmt.Printf("%T = %v\n", s, s)
    fmt.Printf("%T = %c\n", r, r)
    fmt.Printf("%T = %c\n", by, by)
}
```

# Primitive Data Types

## Integer

Go has several integer sizes:

| Type | Size | Range |
|---|---|---|
| `int8` | 8 bit | -128 to 127 |
| `int16` | 16 bit | -32,768 to 32,767 |
| `int32` | 32 bit | -2,147,483,648 to 2,147,483,647 |
| `int64` | 64 bit | -9.2×10¹⁸ to 9.2×10¹⁸ |
| `int` | 32 or 64 bit | Platform dependent |
| `uint8` | 8 bit | 0 to 255 |
| `uint16` | 16 bit | 0 to 65,535 |
| `uint32` | 32 bit | 0 to 4,294,967,295 |
| `uint64` | 64 bit | 0 to 1.8×10¹⁹ |
| `uint` | 32 or 64 bit | Platform dependent |

```go
import "math"

var a int = 42
var b int64 = 9_000_000_000  // underscore as separator
var c uint = 255

fmt.Println(math.MaxInt)    // max value for int
fmt.Println(math.MaxInt64)  // max value for int64
```

## Float

```go
var f32 float32 = 3.14          // ~6-7 digit precision
var f64 float64 = 3.14159265358 // ~15-17 digit precision (recommended)

fmt.Printf("float32: %.7f\n", f32) // 3.1400001 (precision error)
fmt.Printf("float64: %.11f\n", f64) // 3.14159265358
```

## Boolean

```go
var yes bool = true
var no  bool = false

fmt.Println(yes && no)  // false (AND)
fmt.Println(yes || no)  // true  (OR)
fmt.Println(!yes)       // false (NOT)
```

## String

Strings in Go are **immutable** sequences of bytes (cannot be changed after creation).

```go
var s string = "Hello, Go!"

fmt.Println(len(s))    // 10 (byte length)
fmt.Println(s[0])      // 72 (byte value of 'H')
fmt.Println(s[0:5])    // Hello (slice)
fmt.Println(s + " " + "World") // concatenation
```

### Iterating over a string
```go
for i, r := range "Go!" {
    fmt.Printf("index %d: %c (%d)\n", i, r, r)
}
```

## Rune (int32) and Byte (uint8)

```go
var r rune = 'A'       // rune = int32, for Unicode characters
var b byte = 'z'       // byte = uint8, for ASCII characters

fmt.Println(r)         // 65 (ASCII code of 'A')
fmt.Printf("%c\n", r) // A
fmt.Println(b)         // 122 (ASCII code of 'z')
```

Difference between rune and byte:
- `byte` (`uint8`) — for ASCII characters (0-127)
- `rune` (`int32`) — for Unicode characters (supports all languages)

## Full Example of All Types

```go
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
    var i int = 100
    var f float64 = 9.81
    var b bool = true
    var s string = "Golang"
    var r rune = '\u00e9'  // é
    var by byte = 'A'

    fmt.Printf("%T = %v\n", i, i)
    fmt.Printf("%T = %v\n", f, f)
    fmt.Printf("%T = %v\n", b, b)
    fmt.Printf("%T = %v\n", s, s)
    fmt.Printf("%T = %c\n", r, r)
    fmt.Printf("%T = %c\n", by, by)
}
```

quiz.question_id: Pernyataan mana yang paling akurat tentang `int` dibanding `int64` menurut lesson?
quiz.question_en: Which statement is most accurate about `int` compared with `int64` according to the lesson?
options_id: `int` bisa 32 atau 64 bit tergantung platform, sedangkan `int64` selalu 64 bit
`int` dan `int64` selalu punya range yang sama
options_en: `int` can be 32 or 64 bits depending on the platform, while `int64` is always 64-bit
`int` and `int64` always have the same range

quiz.question_en: Why does the example `var b int64 = 9_000_000_000` use `int64`?
options_id: Karena nilainya jauh melampaui range integer kecil seperti `int8` atau `int16`
Karena hanya `int64` yang dapat dicetak oleh `fmt.Println`
options_en: Because underscores are only valid on `int64`
Because the value far exceeds the range of small integer types like `int8` or `int16`
Because only `int64` can be printed by `fmt.Println`

quiz.question_en: What is the role of the underscore in the literal `9_000_000_000`?
options_id: Memisahkan digit untuk keterbacaan tanpa mengubah nilainya
Menambahkan tiga nol di akhir saat runtime
options_en: It turns the number into hexadecimal
It separates digits for readability without changing the value
It explicitly marks the type as `int64`
It adds three trailing zeros at runtime
